name: Kanban Embed
changes: The Kanban Embed notice for a Pro feature now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Add hide-done: true to a kanban-embed block to hide checked cards and show how many are hidden.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Kanban Embed is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your tasks in order.

related.name: Task Date Links
related.blurb: Link completed tasks to their daily notes for backlinks.

related.name: Kanban Draft Vault
related.blurb: Keep new-card drafts and copy lost text from a recovery list.

related.name: Bases Task Rows
related.blurb: Shows each checklist task in the notes a base selects as its own row, with due dates, tags and the source note, and ticks tasks from the view.
